title: Y Combinator insurance tech alum Angle Health hits $2.7B valuation | TechCrunch
summary: Angle Health, a winter 2020 YC alum, helps small businesses obtain and manage what’s known as “level-funded health plans.” These are plans that land between fully insured and self-funded plans.
